To find the stationary points of a function y = f(x), first, find the first derivative of the function, f'(x). Set the first derivative equal to zero and solve for x to find the critical points. Next, find the second derivative of the function, f''(x). Evaluate the second derivative at each critical point. If f''(x) > 0, the point is a local minimum.
